tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders
The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory
The Consultant should be a Company registered under the Indian Companies Act 1956

To qualify for award of this contract, the Consultant in its name in the last five years (i.e., Fy 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26) should have achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs. 1500.00 Lakhs from Consultancy Services
Possession and Owner of at least Two (2) sets of NSV (mounted with Differential GPS, camera, laser etc), One (1) set of FWD and One (1) set of BIV in the bidder name
Maintenance support of at least One (1) Road Asset Management Systems / Software in last 3 years
Providing Annual Maintenance Services for data collection and Asset Management software through OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers) at least one (1) contract in last 3 years
Consultant should have an established office in Karnataka, preferably in Bangalore

Satisfactorily completed one (1) assignment costing not less than Rs.638.00 lakhs (Rupees Four hundred lakhs) of similar nature, i.e Consultancy Services related to Maintenance, Running, Operation Collection of Data & Analyisis for Asset Management Projects in single contract of road in last 5 years

Experience in collecting data using Falling Weight Deflectometer (FWD) or better technology for pavement strength measurement for a minimum 3,000 Kms of road in single contract in the last 5 years (Certificate from an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or District Level Officer should be enclosed) The client reserves the right for the verification of such documents submitted

Experience in collecting data using Network Survey Vehicle (NSV) with laser-based technology or better technology for Pavement Inspection for a minimum 18,000 Kms in single contract of road in last 5 years (Certificate from an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or District Level Officer should be enclosed) The client reserves the right for the verification of such documents submitted
Experience in collecting data using Mobile Bridge Inspection Unit or better technology for bridge inspection for a Minimum of 100 Bridges in last 5 years
Experience in analyzing various data in Asset Management system /software in last 3 years
Joint Venture or Association is not allowed
